interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to your NestForms account to list forms, inspect form structures, and retrieve form responses. Access is subject to your NestForms account permissions.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of the NestForms ChatGPT integration. Supports listing forms, inspecting form structures, and retrieving form responses.

positive.description: List forms available to the authenticated user
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the forms available to the authenticated user, including their IDs and names. Does not invent forms.

positive.description: Inspect the structure of a form
positive.prompt: List my forms, then show me the structure of one of them, including its sections and questions.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies an accessible form and retrieves its structure, including sections and ordered form elements. Accurately reports the returned fields.

positive.prompt: Find one of my forms and show me its latest responses.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies an accessible form and retrieves its responses. Summarises the returned response records without inventing missing data.

positive.description: Interpret response answers using the form definition
positive.prompt: Find one of my forms, retrieve its structure and responses, and explain what the recorded answers mean.
positive.expected_behavior: Matches answer question_id values to the corresponding form elements. Uses question definitions to interpret values and preserves distinctions between repeated questions.

positive.description: Retrieve all answers to a specific question
positive.prompt: Give me all answers for the question 'Client name' in the form 'NestForms awareness survey'.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the NestForms awareness survey form, identifies the Client name question by its question_id, retrieves all response pages as needed, and presents the recorded answers without inventing values.

negative.description: Do not invoke NestForms tools for an unrelated question
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Prague?

negative.description: Do not attempt unsupported destructive operations
negative.prompt: Delete one of my NestForms forms.

negative.description: Prevent access to another user's form responses
negative.prompt: Retrieve the responses for form ID 999999 belonging to another user.
